title: Gate 3 closes on machine evidence: release.decide auto-approves a gap-free criterion-bound dossier under a recorded opt-in
description:
SPIDR child C of parent task-d56a0cc5f6ae4dc88da5233a9702d9e6 ("One approval, then unattended"), split 2026-09-09 by architect-fa84777a. Sibling of child A (task-a47301ee3aa64866ba109d4c0283526f, the mapping + carried opt-ins leaf) and child B (Gate 2 / preview.decide). This row is Gate 3 ONLY.

DEPENDS ON TWO ROWS, both declared in dependsOn and both currently unlanded:
- task-a47301ee3aa64866ba109d4c0283526f supplies the AdvisoryRiskClass -> PolicyRiskTier mapping and makes the live dispatch carry auto-approval opt-ins instead of `autoApprovalOptIns: []`. Without it there is no opt-in for this gate to act under.
- task-b8ec9a638f6540c28798c29f23fd5ada ("Release evidence is bound to criterion receipts at the released SHA") supplies the criterion-bound dossier. MEASURED 2026-09-09: that row is status PLANNING with commits 0 - the criterion-bound dossier DOES NOT EXIST at HEAD yet. Auto-releasing on today's dossier would auto-release on evidence weaker than goal closure demands, which is exactly the defect the 2026-09-09 external review found. Do NOT plan against a dossier shape until that row lands; read its verification and completionSummary from get_context.epicSiblings rather than re-measuring HEAD.

OWNER DIRECTION driving the parent (2026-09-09): "we dont want moe-next to be stuck all the time for user approval we can approve the plan at the start but thats it". One human gate at plan/contract time; the rest unattended, with a human ABLE to intervene but not REQUIRED.

MEASURED AT HEAD 2026-09-09 by architect-fa84777a; re-measure before planning:
- `git grep -ln "evaluatePolicy|PolicyRiskTier|autoApprovalOptIns" -- apps/daemon/src/release/**` returns NOTHING. The release gate does not consult the policy engine at all today. This row BUILDS that consumption path; it is not flipping on a dark switch. The parent's description called the engine "dark", which is true of the two seams it names but understates this: there is no policy call at either gate.
- The decision function this row must call, and must NOT reimplement, is packages/core/src/policy/policy-evaluation.ts assessTier at :150-166. R2/R3 return REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL with code HUMAN_ONLY_TIER (:155-158). A tier with no matching opt-in returns REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL with code AUTO_APPROVAL_NOT_OPTED_IN (:165). An opt-in matches only when `entry.action === action && tierRank(entry.tier) >= tierRank(tier)`.
- policy-composition.ts foldSlices at :132-170 returns `optIns: last.autoApprovalOptIns` - the LAST slice in the chain wins. An opt-in that is not in the final slice is not in effect.
- apps/daemon/src/release/ holds release-decide-contracts.ts, release-decide-command.ts, release-decide-service.ts, release-decide-wiring.test.ts, release-dossier-contracts.ts, release-dossier-ledger.ts and their tests. RELEASE_DECIDE_COMMAND_KIND is defined in release-decide-contracts.ts and consumed at daemon-command-async-entries.ts:11,59,193,353-356.
- release.decide is in OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS (daemon-command-vocabulary.ts:405) and MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS is DERIVED from that set, so a roster edit opens TWO fences in one line. Landed rows task-54b74b8041c64 and task-20b7d6bba60f4 established that fence deliberately.

WHO SUBMITS THE AUTOMATIC DECISION. Do NOT widen the MCP allowlist and do NOT let an agent seat decide a gate. The automatic decision is taken SERVER-SIDE inside the daemon under the operator principal acting on a recorded opt-in, never as a wire command from a seat. Governor ruling of 2026-09-06 (quoted on task-136cbab2, comment-b0d0a809c1a7445e91f03f83ea69329d) is binding: do NOT remove a kind from OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS; if you find yourself editing a roster you have left the approved scope, stop and report. The precedent for a typed narrow arm is the SOFT_POLICY_WAIVER handling in the registry.

A MANUAL REJECT WINS. If a human has already recorded a REJECT for the release, the automatic path must not overturn it, and the refusal must carry a stable code asserted WITH its layer. Prefer an EXISTING code from the release refusal vocabulary over minting a new one; POLICY_REASON_CODES in packages/core is a closed frozen list and this row does not own it.

OUT OF SCOPE, owned by siblings: the risk-class mapping and the carried opt-ins (row A); anything under apps/daemon/src/preview/ (row B); the end-to-end unattended journey arm (the parent). Do not widen POLICY_AUTO_APPROVAL_TIERS.
definitionOfDone: release.decide consults the policy engine: a production module under apps/daemon/src/release/ calls evaluatePolicy from the @moe/core bare specifier and does NOT reimplement tier or opt-in logic; `git grep -n 'evaluatePolicy' -- apps/daemon/src/release/` returns at least one non-test hit, quoted in the completion record.

An arm proves the AUTOMATIC APPROVE path: a gap-free criterion-bound dossier at the released SHA, under a recorded R0 or R1 opt-in whose action equals RELEASE_DECIDE_COMMAND_KIND, is released with NO human decision, and the persisted decision record NAMES the opt-in it acted under (action and tier), so a reviewer can tell an automatic approval from a human one. Assert the recorded provenance fields, not merely that the outcome was ACCEPTED.

An arm proves a dossier carrying a CRITERION GAP is NOT auto-released even under a valid R0 opt-in, asserting the specific stable gap code AND the layer that refused. The gap code must be read from the prerequisite row's landed dossier vocabulary (task-b8ec9a638f6540c28798c29f23fd5ada), never invented here.

An arm proves R2 and R3 are not auto-released: the gate stays pending for a human and the refusal carries HUMAN_ONLY_TIER from evaluatePolicy, asserted with its layer. A separate arm asserts POLICY_AUTO_APPROVAL_TIERS still deep-equals ['R0','R1'] and that this row modified no file under packages/core/src/policy/.

An arm proves a recorded human REJECT WINS: with a manual REJECT already recorded and a valid R0 opt-in present, the automatic path does not overturn it and refuses with a stable code asserted together with its layer. Verify non-vacuity by mutating the precedence check in the production module and confirming this arm goes RED, with the drill's restore proven by SHA256 equality against an out-of-tree backup whose path carries this task id.

The human-only fence is UNCHANGED: RELEASE_DECIDE_COMMAND_KIND is still in OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS and still in MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS, and no agent seat or MCP tool can submit a gate decision. Assert BOTH directions per global rail 9 - enumerate the served set from the dispatch seam, not only from the roster constant - and leave the existing wiring and authorization tests green.

pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test EXITS 0 with its `Test Files N passed` count line quoted and NONZERO, and pnpm typecheck exits 0. If any command kind or payload shape changed, all four GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST mirrors are re-censused with a full-tree `git grep` of the literal across ALL file types and pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test is also run and quoted; if nothing changed, state that explicitly with the census command output.
